about: The freeze of the door's first run on Kaggle: each file's SHA-256 as it stood before anything was pushed, held by test_kaggle_frozen.py. A change is a new freeze, in its own commit, with its reason.
on_whose_word: the maintainer's, to the cloud session: "come up with the next few and run them"
against: demo/shared-runs/study/runs, the first study's kept runs

rules.K1: passes when every folder that came back ended is whole by its seal, its log holds, its seal's signature holds, and its signer is in the ring
rules.K2: passes when each machine's part in each round is the first study's: the same jobs, from, stepped, ended, outcome and SHA-256, and the same states kept
rules.K3: passes when every first-round part was carried on or said it began over, and at least one was cut inside a job; none cut inside is not tested
rules.K4: passes when the ten shared runs step 336379 steps, the first study's
rules.K5: passes when the check stepped every kept state of all ten folders, found every one the same, and every halt the memory names halts
rules.K6: passes when each later round took in its own place's earlier rounds and nothing else, each as enrolled

measured: the parts begun over on another kind
not_tested_is_not_passed: a folder that did not come back leaves a rule not tested
not_frozen: the identities, which are made when the notebooks are and kept outside the repository; the Kaggle account
